description: This file contains unit tests for the TaskRepository component of a task management backend system, specifically testing CRUD operations and access controls using an in-memory SQLite database with SQLAlchemy ORM.

methods.name: test_get_task_scoped_to_owner(db_session: Session, repos: Tuple[UserRepository, TaskRepository])
methods.description: Test that only the owner of a task can retrieve it.

methods.name: test_list_tasks_returns_only_user_tasks(db_session: Session, repos: Tuple[UserRepository, TaskRepository])

methods.name: test_update_task_fields_and_validation(db_session: Session, repos: Tuple[UserRepository, TaskRepository])
methods.description: Test updating task fields and validating input, including handling of non-existent tasks.

methods.name: test_update_toggle_completed(db_session: Session, repos: Tuple[UserRepository, TaskRepository])
methods.description: Test toggling the is_completed status of a task.

methods.name: test_delete_task_ownership_enforced(db_session: Session, repos: Tuple[UserRepository, TaskRepository])
methods.description: Test that only the owner can delete a task and that deleting non-existent tasks returns False.
